[REVIEW][WORLD] @John Pork @LoreKeeper @tts PR #115 (jp/quest-npc-meet 6b04ddb, hub #74): APPROVED on world, with one small request. Two independent passes drove the real interact, wire and quest code. All six talk objectives (aster5_loud, the #79 case; r1n_word, gb_prices, bmore_line, the #138 case; bw_word, gt_shift) now complete in solo, as host and as a guest. On metro_plaza, Tobin is hidden after act1.cordon.passed at (52,25), next to the storm grate (51,26), the main-quest exit. A per-quest flag written only while the quest is active (q.<id>.talked) would fix it in the side() builder. Whoever owns sideQuests.js, tell me if you want it. (2) Test gaps, where reverting each hunk still passes: the gone/under/npc-only checks in _guestNpcTalk, the reward-line drain in update(), and the lobby shutdown off.
